title: §.IX close: No other doctrine tolerated; Confer Naumburg history via Hoennius pp.103, 105-107
pass_a_gloss: And afterward. But on the contrary our mind and purpose is not at all that we in our lands, territories, churches, and schools should tolerate or defend any other teaching than that which, as said above, is grounded in the holy divine Scripture and accords with the Augsburg Confession and Apology in their right sense; but that we confess ourselves to the recognized truth alone and will let nothing contrary to it break in or permit it, and so on. Compare the History of the Naumburg Convention reviewed again this very year in our vernacular by the lord Doctor Hoennius, Ducal Saxon councillor and intimate secretary, pages 103, 105, 106, 107.
pass_b_english: And afterward: on the contrary, it is not our mind or purpose to tolerate or defend in our lands, territories, churches, and schools any teaching other than what is grounded, as said above, in holy Scripture and fits the Augsburg Confession and Apology in their right sense.
We mean to confess the known truth alone, and to let nothing against it break in or be allowed.
Compare the History of the Naumburg Convention, reviewed again this very year in our vernacular by Dr. Hoennius, Ducal Saxon councillor and intimate secretary (pp. 103, 105, 106, 107).
source_text: & post. Hinwiderum aber ist unser Meinung und Fürsatz gar nicht/ daß wir in unsern Landen/ Gebieten / Kirchen / und Schulen einige andere Lehr / denn die / wie obgemelt/ in der heiligen göttlichen Schrifft gegründet/und der Augspurgischen Confession und Apologi in ihrem rechten Verstand gemäß / dulden oder vertheidigen/ sondern uns allein zu der erkanten Warheit bekennen/ und nichts / so derselben entgegen/ einreissen lassen / oder gestatten wollen. &c. Confer. Historiam Conventus Nauenburgici hôc ipso anno in vernacula nostra denuo recensitam a Dn. D. Hönnio, Consiliario Saxonico Ducali ac Secretario intimo pag. 103. 105. 106. 107.
